items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: You knew old man Jim Humphreys, you said, huh? ... The old man. Yeah, the old man.

ctx.x: That's right. It seems to me.
I don't know. I just fooled around with them a little bit, but I can play them. Let's see. You knew old man Jim Humphreys, you said, huh?

The old man. Yeah, the old man. The Willie Graham. The old man. Yeah. The old man. Yeah. They lived on Clow or Willow Street, between Janet and Cadiz. They used to go there and take my lessons. I was going to school then, but I was going to take my lessons. Where I went. Up around Cadiz and Liberty I think. Oh yeah. Yeah.
